geo07.reason: Candidates span north/south/west architecture with visible depth, but no 3D noncoplanarity assertion is possible until paired model features are corrected/registered. Four window points share a plane and cannot alone prove a noncoplanar set. Cube tile index does not assign a measured geographic azimuth. Default viewer fov80 is not tile camera calibration.
